answer: Random committee audits: each epoch a verifiable random draw picks 7 staked auditors who re-check 10% of every identity's attestations. Each identity posts a 25 POA bond, and a failed audit slashes 60% of it. An operator trying to forge a hundred keys must lock 100 bonds and faces ten times the sampled work, so the odds of detection rise with every fake. Like tasting a pinch of saffron, a small random sample exposes the batch, and the kernel of each audit is a signed result anyone can verify on-chain.
